g.title: j335667532
g.text: MomToxicated: Have you reconsidered being cooperative, "Drifter?"

g.title: j1935713821->j335667532
g.text: false

g.title: j1795186788
g.text: I just wish I had better answers for you.

g.title: j1781480310
g.text: Is she always like that?

g.title: j3103583292
g.text: Lol. It's fine.

g.title: j2345462383
g.text: Have you decided to be less of a bitch, "Minerva?"

g.title: j4019954641
g.text: Can we... just drop the attitude? Please? I'm not your enemy.

g.title: j601342776
g.text: What in the ever-loving Void is your problem with me?

g.title: j1266044957
g.text: PapaPolar: look, maybe if you knew why it was important that we're here.

g.title: j2438381529
g.text: MomToxicated: Yes.

g.title: j108333747
g.text: MomToxicated: Oh, you sweet thing, you haven't seen anything yet.

g.title: j2538477112
g.text: MomToxicated: Aw, begging already. Too bad.

g.title: j3616555445
g.text: MomToxicated: The problem I have is that *you* have information *I* need.

g.title: j3270554750
g.text: PapaPolar: and why we were looking for neci.

g.title: j1240135252
g.text: Lol. Whoops. Forgot. Group chat. Sorry.

g.title: j3226745148
g.text: Oh. Um. Hi.

g.title: j1459795532
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j435138403
g.text: Check boolean MinervaNeci1

g.title: j2960288115
g.text: PapaPolar: see, minerva and i are from libertatia

g.title: j4277466587
g.text: Still getting used to this whole... past technology thing.

g.title: j1579515192
g.text: MomToxicated: Fine. You made your point. But if you want me to break out the lipstick, you're going to need to work for it, pipsqueak.

g.title: j3371036132
g.text: MomToxicated: And you want to give me the same fake non-answers as the rest of the so-called "Hex."

g.title: j435138403->j3371036132
g.text: true

g.title: j1459438595
g.text: MomToxicated: And you're refusing to play ball.

g.title: j435138403->j1459438595
g.text: false

g.title: j1000216109
g.text: MomToxicated: Velimir. Are you disclosing highly classified information?

g.title: j3087307251
g.text: PapaPolar: i love that you're from the high-tech future, AND bad at this. X-D

g.title: j2416400159
g.text: Just because you don't like my answer doesn't make it fake.

g.title: j106199766
g.text: I'm not giving you non-answers. What you're asking me really has no *good* answer.

g.title: j161329080
g.text: I wonder why that is?

g.title: j2254531999
g.text: Well, maybe if you weren't being so vicious, I'd be more willing to talk to you.

g.title: j799681781
g.text: MomToxicated: On overseas, private sector servers?

g.title: j938664217
g.text: PapaPolar: freakin' adorable. lolol

g.title: j3101026958
g.text: MomToxicated: Mm. I know your type. Lua, not another one of you bleeding heart mercenaries...

g.title: j3545612885
g.text: MomToxicated: Under an unregistered asset username?

g.title: j3799565675
g.text: MomToxicated: Can we please focus? We aren't here to make friends.

g.title: j2870315603
g.text: MomToxicated: Blast in, save the world, toss the coat over your shoulder while you walk out, "you wouldn't understand my pain," lonely loner types.

g.title: j1483415617
g.text: MomToxicated: With your real civilian name?

g.title: j1527324226
g.text: PapaPolar: i mean...?

g.title: j1309489558
g.text: And what's wrong with that?

g.title: j4167800458
g.text: You don't know the first thing about me, lady.

g.title: j1284527593
g.text: MomToxicated: Again?

g.title: j2921570370
g.text: MomToxicated: What were you two discussing?

g.title: j1705577183
g.text: MomToxicated: If I have to explain it, you wouldn't understand.

g.title: j367223079
g.text: MomToxicated: Mmhm.

g.title: j1621834288
g.text: PapaPolar: :-C

g.title: j311167567
g.text: PapaPolar: i was just thinking that maybe if we told our *new friend* here why we were looking for neci

g.title: j550193198
g.text: PapaPolar: M, please stop. we need their help, why're you doing this?

g.title: j1070291014
g.text: MomToxicated: I. Am going to just ignore that. "Drifter," I am simply going to cut right to the chase. I have no patience left for anything else.

g.title: j3823184316
g.text: MomToxicated: Velimir, were you about to disclose highly classified information?

g.title: j1942974882
g.text: MomToxicated: Because they've told everyone the same line of shit. "We don't know what's happened to her, or if that's really her anymore."

g.title: j2780265674
g.text: Check boolean MinervaNeci1

g.title: j951359644
g.text: MomToxicated: And I don't buy it.

g.title: j2543094113
g.text: MomToxicated: Major Neci Rusalka. And I am to believe that you have information on her. Key information.

g.title: j2780265674->j2543094113
g.text: true

g.title: j3476086788
g.text: MomToxicated: We are here looking for the truth about Major Neci Rusalka. And I am to believe that you have information on her. Key information.

g.title: j2780265674->j3476086788
g.text: false

g.title: j2949895328
g.text: Check boolean MinervaNeci1

g.title: j2770799419
g.text: PapaPolar: M, shit's sake, we talked about this.

g.title: j2309837808
g.text: Boolean MinervaNeci1 is now true.

g.title: j2854605634
g.text: If you let me explain, for two seconds, maybe you'd believe me.

g.title: j2949895328->j2854605634
g.text: true

g.title: j3573141615
g.text: I *don't* know what's happened to her! That's the literal Void's honest truth.

g.title: j2949895328->j3573141615
g.text: true

g.title: j4085891377
g.text: What the hell is this about?

g.title: j2949895328->j4085891377
g.text: false

g.title: j3923638446
g.text: Who's "she?"

g.title: j2949895328->j3923638446
g.text: false

g.title: j1852645210
g.text: This is getting ridiculous.

g.title: j641897551
g.text: Are you saying you think I'm responsible?

g.title: j352144603
g.text: MomToxicated: And I am to believe that you have information on her. Key information.

g.title: j4111838413
g.text: MomToxicated: We are here looking for the truth about Major Neci Rusalka. And I am to believe that you have information on her. Key information.

g.title: j1714233510
g.text: MomToxicated: Did you or did you not have anything to do with what's happened to her?

g.title: j2608977807
g.text: MomToxicated: Are you saying you're not?

g.title: j1915928231
g.text: The thing that's responsible for what's happened to her is a giant, unknowable Void god. You want to pick a fight with him? Be my guest and get in line.

g.title: j2529284382
g.text: Yes and no? Look, it's not like I shot her in the head. I didn't. Even when I had a chance to. ...Okay, there were the rockets, but that's different.

g.title: j16846457
g.text: What's happened to her is complicated, lady. And I don't appreciate your tone.

g.title: j4174074062
g.text: Short of it is - I don't have a beef with her, and I'm doing my best to hold shit together around here.

g.title: j603904410
g.text: I'll help you if I can, but you're not giving me any reason to right now.

g.title: j3298678278
g.text: So, lady? Can you not?

g.title: j1185801190
g.text: So please, take it down a notch.

g.title: j2288449428
g.text: MomToxicated: If you think I'm just going to sit around here with my thumb up my ass -

g.title: j517044221
g.text: PapaPolar: hey hey, cool down, M.

g.title: j3138754216
g.text: PapaPolar: i've talked to all the others about the situation, and all their stories line up. what drifter here is saying is right.

g.title: j3168377311
g.text: PapaPolar: they don't have any more answers than anybody else. and this ain't their fault.

g.title: j2449485900
g.text: PapaPolar: the story's too wild for them all to keep that amount of bullshit straight if it weren't the truth, you know that lol.

g.title: j2853390921
g.text: MomToxicated: So you want me to just accept the fact that she's *gone.*

g.title: j1581854737
g.text: MomToxicated: That we came all the way here to find her and she's *GONE.*

g.title: j1735630539
g.text: MomToxicated: That our little neci is

g.title: j3457349371
g.text: PapaPolar: it'll be okay, M. we'll find some way to find her. to get in contact with her.

g.title: j1696306630
g.text: PapaPolar: maybe our new "friend" here could help us, if we, y'know, played nice?

g.title: j462396330
g.text: PapaPolar: ....?

g.title: j3385200113
g.text: PapaPolar: M?

g.title: j61577685
g.text: I think she signed off.

g.title: j1350087053
g.text: Yikes.

g.title: j34979906
g.text: PapaPolar: try not to hold it against her, if you can. wouldn't blame you if you did, mind.

g.title: j498596161
g.text: PapaPolar: she's just... real scared.

g.title: j13063907
g.text: PapaPolar: some folks get mean when they feel like they've got no other option.

g.title: j2838834317
g.text: I get it. Double whammy with the military background.

g.title: j3856364623
g.text: I'm getting used to people attacking me lately. It's fine.

g.title: j519685255
g.text: Well, it's not an excuse to act like that.

g.title: j2039394554
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1223712723
g.text: PapaPolar: again, it's easy when they're scared. look real hard at most times people are acting like little shits in this world, and it generally comes down to two things:

g.title: j2014499958
g.text: PapaPolar: no, you're 100% right. it's not. but people are messes, and sometimes we love them for it anyway. and sometimes, we even forgive them for it.

g.title: j557872883
g.text: PapaPolar: nail on the head.

g.title: j2123742449
g.text: PapaPolar: fear 'n greed.

g.title: j3132199207
g.text: PapaPolar: but that's neither here nor there. not your fault she's coming guns blazing, we owe you an apology.

g.title: j361711553
g.text: PapaPolar: there are only so many ways to get ahead in life when you're a lady in the military. in short? means she's used to having to shout sometimes to be taken seriously

g.title: j1687230081
g.text: None needed. Let's just work this out tomorrow.

g.title: j639062292
g.text: Thanks.

g.title: j958399380
g.text: *You* don't. *She* does.

g.title: j1374846078
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j731752357
g.text: PapaPolar: talk soon.

g.title: j928547583
g.text: PapaPolar: yeah, well. better learn to hold your breath for a while.

g.title: j1735639520
g.text: PapaPolar: sounds good, lil buddy.

g.text: +20 Chemistry
